messages:
Amy (Sales): quick sync — AcmeCorp wants a 2-week on‑prem POC in a sealed datacenter. They listed requirements: offline bundle + signed manifest, clear rollback path, cert rotation plan, explicit upgrade cadence, and a one-off packaging price. any immediate blockers?
Devon (Solutions Eng): we can produce a minibundle (quantized model + slim runtime). need to confirm allowed libc/driver versions inside sealed DC. signing: do they accept cosign signatures or require our key escrow? @maria-security?
Maria (Security): cosign is preferred. if they want us to hold the signing key we need an AAR + POA from legal. also need confirmation on telemetry opt-out & whether we ship with telemetry disabled by default.
Ron (SRE): ops notes: initial transfer bandwidth is the main constraint. example: an LLM bundle w/ weights ~12GB + runtime ~1.2GB. recommend delta updates for hotfixs instead of full re-bundles. rollback: operator supports version pinning + a forced revert flag.
Amy (Sales): they asked about upgrade cadence — customer prefers monthly security patches, quarterly feature rolls. how does that change cost?
Devon (Solutions Eng): packaging premium: one-time packaging+signing fee for initial sealed bundle, then per-delta update charge. rough back-of-envelope: initial engineering package + QA = TBD ($7k–15k range depending on testing), per-delta ~ $1k–2k. will produce official quote.
Kai (Customer Eng): customer also wants an emergency hotfix path (within 72h) for critical CVEs. we need an ops playbook for hotfix delivery into sealed envs.
Maria (Security): 72h hotfix viable if we pre-agree an emergency signing process and provide a signed delta manifest. also need to document acceptance tests and rollback criteria.
Devon (Solutions Eng): example manifest snippet we'd include in bundle:
```json
{
  "bundle_version": "2026-03-11-1",
  "components": ["model.bin","runtime.tar.gz","lib.tar.gz"],
  "signatures": {"cosign": "<sig>"}
}
```
Ron (SRE): CI note: building sealed bundles will go thru deploy-bot job. see job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/789 (kicking now) :gear:
deploy-bot: build started for bundle 2026-03-11-1 — artifacts will land in GCS staging bucket (sha256 manifest attached).
Amy (Sales): perfect. next steps: 1) Devon to list exact file/OS constraints customer must accept, 2) Maria to draft brief AAR checklist and telemetry opt-out wording, 3) Ron to draft transfer bandwidth/rollback playbook and emergency hotfix SLA language. I'll sync with customer and loop back on pricing.
Devon (Solutions Eng): will deliver file constraints + sample manifest by EOD.
Maria (Security): will share AAR template and telemetry checklist by EOD.
Ron (SRE): I'll draft the playbook + transfer checklist tomorrow morning.
Amy (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup: — posting this as the POC action list to the SOW thread after customer call.
thread_context: POC coordination, on-prem sealed datacenter packaging, signing/upgrade cadence, pricing and emergency hotfix path
